items.question: Shipbuilders, Inc., anticipates profits for the second quarter to be -...- 4 and 6 percent.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“between”代入题干后为“Shipbuilders, Inc., anticipates profits for the second quarter to be -...- 4 and 6 percent. [between]”。选择理由：该项同时满足句法结构、固定搭配和句意要求，其余选项至少有一项不符。正确答案：D（between）。
